title: What is the Max plan? | Claude Help Center

facts.fact: The Max plan for individual consumers is available for $100 per month, according to Anthropic's help center.
facts.quote: The Max plan is available for $100 per month.

facts.fact: Anthropic states that price and plans for the Max plan are subject to change at Anthropic's discretion.
facts.quote: Price and plans are subject to change at Anthropic's discretion.

facts.fact: Anthropic says it does not offer standard discounted pricing for individual plans (Pro, Max, and Ultra).
facts.quote: We don't offer standard discounted pricing for individual plans (Pro, Max, and Ultra), but anyone in a supported location can access the free version of Claude

facts.fact: Anthropic states its Support team cannot issue one-off discounts or coupons for Claude plans.
facts.quote: Our Support team cannot issue one-off discounts or coupons.

facts.fact: Anthropic states that discounted pricing on Team and Enterprise plans is available to eligible nonprofit organizations.
facts.quote: Eligible nonprofit organizations can get discounted pricing on Team and Enterprise plans.

facts.fact: According to Anthropic, the Max plan includes five times the Pro plan's usage every five hours and every week.
facts.quote: The Max plan includes five times the Pro plan's usage every five hours and every week.

facts.fact: Max plans have a five-hour usage limit, a weekly usage limit across all models, and a separate weekly limit for Fable.
facts.quote: Max plans have a five-hour limit, a weekly usage limit that applies across all models, and a separate weekly limit for Fable.

facts.fact: The weekly usage limit for Max plans resets at a fixed time each week assigned to the user's account, and users receive their full weekly allowance each cycle.
facts.quote: The weekly limit resets at a fixed time each week that is assigned to your account.

facts.fact: Anthropic states that Max plans may face additional usage limits such as weekly and monthly caps, and that it does not guarantee uninterrupted service.
facts.quote: Additional usage limits may apply to manage capacity and ensure fair access to all users.
